object type: Smartshift Retrofit - Step 1: Getting TR List

description.overview: Step 1 of the Smartshift Retrofit process involves receiving, validating, and scoping transport requests (TRs) shared by the customer for retrofit.
detailed_flow: Customer shares a list of TRs that were moved to their source (ECC) production system during a timeframe defined by them.
Each shared TR is validated to ensure it exists in the ECC production system.
Once validation is complete, scoping preparation begins. Simultaneously, extracts are triggered for in-scope namespaces in both the ECC (source) and S/4HANA (target) systems.
After scoping is reviewed internally, it is sent to the customer for approval, along with Customer_Review, Cust_TOC, and Customer_Review TABU case details.
Completed extracts and finalized scoping are uploaded to the designated Google Drive folder and shared with the Retrofit Analyst team to initiate tool-based analysis.
After receiving customer approval and feedback, the process proceeds to Step 2: Retrofit.

activities.1. Receive TR list: Customer provides the list of TRs moved to ECC production during the defined timeframe.
activities.2. Validate TRs: Verify that each TR in the list exists in the ECC production system.
activities.3. Prepare scoping and trigger extracts: Start scoping for in-scope objects and simultaneously trigger extracts in both ECC and S/4 systems.
activities.4. Review and send for approval: Scoping is reviewed and shared with the customer along with required documents: Customer_Review, Cust_TOC, and Customer_Review TABU.
activities.5. Upload and share with analyst team: All validated and approved artifacts are uploaded to Google Drive and shared with the Retrofit Analyst team.
activities.6. Proceed to next phase: After customer feedback and approval, proceed to the next stage: Retrofit.

comparison notes.context: Thorough validation and preparation in this step are critical to avoid issues in later retrofit stages. Ensuring only in-scope and valid TRs move forward helps streamline the entire retrofit cycle.

common_errors: TRs not found in ECC production system
Incorrect or incomplete TR list shared by customer
best_practices: Cross-check each TR in ECC production system before proceeding
Align with customer on expected timeframe and TR scope
Maintain a standardized scoping and extract process
Share scoping documents clearly with traceable versions
Ensure timely communication with the Retrofit Analyst team
